answers.core: it's already present in the underlying vector API, so we're just exposing it to the GDScript API.
answers.workaround:
it can be worked around with a few lines of code, but the lines of code feel very verbose and less clear in intent than a simple `return array.erase(value)`.

```gdscript
var index := array.find(value)
if index < 0:
	return false
array.pop_at(index)
return true
```

title: Change `Array.erase` API to return `true` if successful
